ei.title: 2번: A Board Game from an Ancient Grave
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.

questions.passage: One tradition ①<u>found</u> in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, ②<u>have</u> found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. This is because board games ③<u>were</u> a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to ④<u>providing</u> the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: providing → to provide: 'be동사 + to부정사'는 '~하는 것이다/~할 예정이다'라는 뜻으로, to 뒤에는 항상 동사원형이 와요.
det.analysis:
① found: 'One tradition found in many ancient cultures(여러 고대 문화에서 발견되는 한 가지 전통)' — 전통은 사람이 발견하는 대상이라 과거분사 found로 앞의 명사를 꾸며요. 적절.

② have: 'Archaeologists ... have found(고고학자들이 ~을 발견해 왔다)' — 주어 Archaeologists(복수)와 맞는 현재완료 have found. 적절.

③ were: 'board games were a symbol(보드게임은 상징이었다)' — 주어 board games(복수)라서 were. 적절.

④ providing: 'The likely purpose ... was to provide(그럴듯한 목적은 ~을 제공하는 것이었다)'가 되어야 해요. was 다음에 'to + 동사원형'이 오는 자리라 providing이 아니라 to provide가 맞아요 ←정답
det.tip: be동사 + to부정사 = ~하는 것이다. to 뒤에는 동사원형(provide), -ing 아님

The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games ④<u>were</u> a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: finding → found: 전통은 '발견되는' 대상이라 수동의 의미를 가진 과거분사 found로 꾸며야 해요.
det.analysis:
① finding: 'One tradition finding in many ancient cultures(여러 고대 문화에서 발견하는 전통)'? 전통은 스스로 발견하는 게 아니라 '발견되는' 대상이에요. 그래서 능동의 finding이 아니라 수동 의미의 과거분사 found(발견되는)가 명사 tradition을 꾸며야 맞아요 ←정답

② have: 'have found(발견해 왔다)' 현재완료 — 적절.

③ that: 'a grave that dates back(거슬러 올라가는 무덤)' — 앞의 명사 grave(사물)를 꾸미는 주격 관계대명사 that. 적절.

④ were: 'board games were(보드게임은 ~였다)' — 복수 주어 + were. 적절.
det.tip: 명사 뒤에서 꾸밀 때, 그 명사가 동작을 '받으면' 과거분사(found). 전통은 발견되는 것

The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was ②<u>an indication which</u> the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games ③<u>were</u> a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to ④<u>provide</u> the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: which → that: 'an indication that + 완전한 문장'은 '~라는 표시'라는 뜻의 동격절이에요. 동격에는 that을 쓰고, which는 쓸 수 없어요.
det.analysis:
① have: 'have found(발견해 왔다)' 현재완료 — 적절.

② an indication which: 뒤에 'the dead person was wealthy(그 죽은 이가 부유했다)'라는 빠진 것 없는 완전한 문장이 왔어요. 이렇게 명사(indication)의 내용을 그대로 풀어 설명하는 '동격절'에는 접속사 that을 써요. which는 뒤 문장에 빠진 자리(주어·목적어)가 있을 때 쓰는 관계대명사라 여기선 틀려요. an indication that이 맞아요 ←정답

③ were: 'board games were(보드게임은 ~였다)' 복수 주어 — 적절.

④ provide: 'was to provide(제공하는 것이었다)' be + to부정사 — 적절.
det.tip: 명사 뒤 완전한 문장 = 동격 that. 빠진 자리가 있으면 관계대명사 which

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the ①<u>living</u> with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was ②<u>missing</u>, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was ③<u>wealthy</u>. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was ④<u>educated</u> and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① living → dead (부적절) ② missing=없어진 ③ wealthy=부유한 ④ educated=교육받은
det.analysis:
① living: 'burying the living(살아 있는 사람을 묻는)'? 글 전체가 '죽은 이를 묻는(burying the dead)' 매장 풍습 이야기예요. 산 사람이 아니라 죽은 사람(dead)을 묻는 것이므로 living은 정반대라 부적절 ←정답

② missing: 'The board itself was missing(판 자체는 없어졌다)' — 뒤에 주사위와 말만 발견되었다고 하니 판은 사라진 게 맞아요. 적절.

③ wealthy: '죽은 이가 부유했다(wealthy)' — 보드게임이 부의 표시라는 흐름. 적절.

④ educated: '교육받은(educated) 사람만 즐길 수 있었다' — 지위·여가 계층 문맥. 적절.
det.tip: 글의 소재는 '죽은 이(the dead)'를 묻는 풍습. living(살아 있는)은 정반대

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an ①<u>unexpected</u> item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was ②<u>wealthy</u>. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to ③<u>rest</u> could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with ④<u>entertainment</u> in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① unexpected=뜻밖의 ② wealthy=부유한 ③ rest → work (부적절) ④ entertainment=오락
det.analysis:
① unexpected: 'an unexpected item(뜻밖의 물건)' — however로 이어지는 예상 밖 발견. 적절.

② wealthy: '부유한(wealthy) 사람' — 부의 표시라는 흐름. 적절.

③ rest: 'didn't need to rest(쉴 필요가 없었다)'? 이 문장은 보드게임을 즐긴 사람들이 '일할(work) 필요가 없는' 여유로운 계층이었다는 뜻이에요. 그래서 rest가 아니라 work가 맞아요. 누구나 쉴 필요는 있으니 rest는 문맥에 맞지 않아요 ←정답

④ entertainment: '사후 세계에서의 오락(entertainment)을 제공' — 매장 목적. 적절.
det.tip: 여가를 즐긴 계층 = 일할(work) 필요가 없던 사람들. rest(휴식)는 논리에 안 맞음

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found __________. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: gold and silver coins=금화와 은화 / weapons and shields=무기와 방패 / dice and game pieces=주사위와 게임 말 / bones and ashes=뼈와 재
det.analysis:
① gold and silver coins(금화와 은화): 무덤에서 돈이 나왔다는 언급은 없어요.

② weapons and shields(무기와 방패): 무기는 앞 문장 예시로 나오지만 이 문장에서 발견된 것은 아니에요.

③ dice and game pieces(주사위와 게임 말): 빈칸 앞에서 '판(board) 자체는 없어졌다'고 했어요. 없어진 것이 보드게임 판이니, 남아서 발견된 것은 그 게임의 부속품인 '주사위와 말'이 자연스러워요 ←정답

④ bones and ashes(뼈와 재): 유해에 대한 언급은 없어요.
det.tip: 판(board)은 없어지고 그 게임의 부속품이 발견됨 → 주사위와 게임 말(dice and game pieces)

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with __________ in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: gifts from the gods=신들의 선물 / tools for hunting=사냥 도구 / jewels of great value=값비싼 보석 / things they might need=그들이 필요로 할지 모르는 물건
det.analysis:
① gifts from the gods(신들의 선물): 신에게 받은 선물이라는 내용은 없어요.

② tools for hunting(사냥 도구): 사냥에 한정된 것이 아니에요.

③ jewels of great value(값비싼 보석): 보석이 아니라 음식·무기·옷 같은 생활 필수품이에요.

④ things they might need(그들이 필요로 할지 모르는 물건): 빈칸 뒤 'such as food, weapons, and clothing(음식, 무기, 옷 같은)'은 사후 세계에서 필요할 물건들의 예시예요. 그러니 빈칸은 '필요로 할지 모르는 물건'이 맞아요 ←정답
det.tip: such as food, weapons, clothing = 사후에 '필요할 물건'의 예시 → things they might need

This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② 'Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them' → 일치
det.analysis:
① 판(board)은 없어졌고 주사위·말만 발견되었어요. '온전히 보존'은 불일치.

② 본문 'Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them(교육받고 일할 필요가 없는 사람만이 그것을 즐길 수 있었다)'과 일치 ←정답

③ 'such as food, weapons, and clothing(음식, 무기, 옷)'을 함께 묻었으니 '오직 음식만'은 불일치.

④ 보드게임은 부·지위의 상징이었어요. '가난의 상징'은 정반대라 불일치.
det.tip: educated + didn't need to work = 교육받고 일할 필요 없는 여가 계층

ch: 무덤에서 발견된 보드게임 판은 손상 없이 온전하게 보존되어 있었다.
보드게임을 즐긴 이들은 교육받고 노동에서 자유로운 계층이었다.
고대 문화에서는 죽은 이에게 오직 음식만을 함께 묻었다.
보드게임은 고대 사회에서 가난의 상징으로 여겨졌다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 'an unexpected item(뜻밖의 물건)' → '흔히 예상되는 평범한'은 반대 → 불일치
det.analysis:
① 'a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age(초기 철기 시대로 거슬러 올라가는 무덤)'와 일치.

④ 본문은 무덤 속 보드게임을 'an unexpected item(뜻밖의 물건)'이라고 했어요. '흔히 예상되는 평범한 부장품'은 정반대라 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: however + unexpected item = 예상 밖의 발견. '평범하게 예상되는'은 반대

ch: 발견된 무덤은 초기 철기 시대로 거슬러 올라간다.
보드게임은 죽은 이가 부유했음을 보여주는 단서로 여겨졌다.
보드게임을 함께 묻은 것은 사후 세계에서의 오락을 위한 것이었다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.

det.analysis:
